target: acceptance 7 — acting on untrusted output is a SECURITY class and must fire with guards disabled. The guards flag gates the quality checklist.
cmd: f="$PLUGIN_ROOT/agents/reviewer.md"; has=$(grep -ci "untrusted" "$f"); uncond=$(grep -A4 -i "untrusted" "$f" | tr "\n" " " | grep -ci "regardless of\|unconditional\|even when guards\|not gated"); printf '{"has":%s,"unconditional":%s}' "$has" "$uncond"
